issue.title: gateway: claudeRoom remakes its freed channel the way filememo did before #3632, so a Claude Code run in a synctest bubble would crash the next release outside it
issue.body:
Came up in the review of #3632. `claudeRoomT.release` closes `c.freed` and makes the next one every time a Claude Code process ends, and `nudge` does the same while an ask waits for room. `claudeRoom` is a package-level var, so if a test ever runs a Claude Code turn inside a synctest bubble, the next `freed` belongs to that bubble. The next release outside it (or an ask that waits on it, or a nudge) is then a fatal error, and it takes the whole gateway test binary down in whichever test runs Claude Code next.

Nothing hits it today: gateway's only synctest tests are TestConcurrentClassification*, which call classify with a fake ask. That's how filememo looked before a provider test wrote in a bubble. A take and release in a bubble, then one outside it, shows it on 098ac969:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble

goroutine 210 [running]:
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway.(*claudeRoomT).release(...)
	internal/gateway/claude_room.go:294
```

The fix would be the same as for filememo: make `freed` only when an ask has to wait, and have release and nudge close it only if one was taken. trace's `wake` already works that way. I'll put a patch here.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3690-claude-room-freed` (head `56b4f317`, on upstream `6afbe3f3`) — `claudeRoom` hands its freed channel to the waiter that needs it, so a run ending outside its bubble is no crash.

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/claude_room.go`'s `release` did `close(c.freed); c.freed = make(chan struct{})` unconditionally, while `nudge` guards the same pair with `if c.waiting > 0`. Closing a channel that belongs to another synctest bubble — or replacing it under a waiter that is already on the old one — is what the report's bubble hit.

**Change.** the channel is now made by the first waiter and dropped with the last: a `wake` helper (used by both `nudge` and `release`) closes and clears it only while `waiting > 0`, and `take` makes it if nil under the same lock it waits with, so no waiter is left on a closed-and-replaced channel.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestClaudeRoom` → `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` at `claudeRoomT.release` (the test binary dies; `claude_room.go:294`)
Green: `same command → `ok`; the room reports 0 runs and 0 waiting afterwards, and an ask waiting on a full room is woken by a release and takes it (`TestClaudeRoomLetsAnIdleRunGoAndItResumes`, `TestClaudeRoomFullIs503` also green)` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway`

This is the same shape as #3632's `filememo` fix, arrived at from the waiter side; nothing else in the file changed.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 26's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6afbe3f3` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3690-claude-room-freed — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.

I was on this one too — yielding to @skygunner's fix branch and verifying it instead of posting a competing patch. I can endorse it: the mechanism is right, it applies to current main cleanly, and every check I ran on it passes.

**Mechanism, link by link** (checked against current main, e17b6cefc):

1. **The second remake site is `release`.** `release` (internal/gateway/claude_room.go:298-299 on main) does `close(c.freed); c.freed = make(chan struct{})` unconditionally — no `waiting` guard — while `nudge` (lines 285-286) guards the same pair with `if c.waiting > 0`. Those are exactly the two sites the report names; `release` is the unguarded one.
2. **The crash path.** `claudeRoom` is a package-level var, so a `take`+`release` inside a synctest bubble leaves the replacement `freed` owned by that bubble; the next `release` outside it closes a foreign channel: `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`.
3. **How the branch blocks each link.** `take` makes `freed` only on the waiting path, under the same lock hold that increments `c.waiting`, so no observer ever sees `waiting > 0` with `freed == nil`; each leaving waiter decrements the count and the last one sets `freed = nil`; `wake()` — now called by both `release` and `nudge` — closes only while `waiting > 0 && freed != nil`. A release nobody waits on closes nothing, so no channel is made that doesn't have a waiter, and none outlives its waiters.
4. **Same shape as #3632's filememo fix** (4842f69be): channel made lazily by the consumer that waits (`take` / filememo's `Written`), closed only if one was taken by a single shared helper (`wake` / filememo's `endWaits`). #3632's own commit message already flags this disease: "internal/gateway's claudeRoom closes and remakes its freed channel the same way … #3690."

**Verification** (darwin/arm64, go1.26.8 via the repo's toolchain directive):

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New test on pre-fix code (their fix reverted to parent code, test kept) | RED — `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` at `(*claudeRoomT).release` claude_room.go:298, from the test's run ending after its bubble (claude_room_test.go:454) — the report's exact signature |
| Branch as pushed, at its own base (`fix/3690-claude-room-freed`, head 56b4f3174 on 6afbe3f3) | `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestClaudeRoom` → ok |
| Applies to current main | base lags main by 1721 commits; the only commit touching claude_room.go since (9a951eb03, cgroup walk) is a disjoint region — `git am -3` applied clean, no conflict (as 569fee17b) |
| New test with fix on main + am | `TestClaudeRoomEndsOutsideItsSynctestBubble` PASS — the woken-ask path really runs (log: "second waits for room" → "second had room after 0s") |
| All room tests | `TestClaudeRoomLetsAnIdleRunGoAndItResumes`, `TestClaudeRoomFullIs503`, `TestClaudeRoomEndsOutsideItsSynctestBubble` all PASS |
| Full touched package | `go test -tags nogui -timeout 25m ./internal/gateway/` → ok, 0 red |
| gofmt (CRLF-safe, `tr -d '\r'` piped) | clean on both changed files |
| `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` | clean |
| Freshness | no upstream commit fixes #3690 (grep over upstream/main finds only #3632's cross-reference); main's `release` still closes/remakes unconditionally |

Branch: skygunner/magpie `fix/3690-claude-room-freed` (head 56b4f3174abc0643854d4d82c1dc8a9b8660dc33)

Not verified: packages beyond internal/gateway, `-race`, and GOOSes other than darwin/arm64.

AI use: verification performed with AI assistance; all commands and outputs above were run and read locally.

Thanks @yinwu01 for the report and @skygunner for the fix branch.

issue.title: pii: a masking request in a synctest bubble would leave srv.stop and the idle timer tied to it, and the next Stop outside it crashes

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Came up in the review of #3690. pii's `srv` is package-level, and two of its fields are made by whoever gets there first: `stopCh()` makes `srv.stop` on classifyTurn's first look and keeps it until Stop, and `idleLocked` makes `srv.idle` after each answered request. If a test ever runs a masking request inside a synctest bubble, both belong to that bubble, and the next `Stop()` outside it, or the next answered request, touching them is a fatal error that takes the test binary down.

Nothing hits it today: pii and masking have no synctest tests, and gateway's bubbles (TestConcurrentClassification*) never reach masking. A probe on 27ca0bef, `stopCh()` in a bubble and then `Stop()` outside it:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:245
```

and `idleLocked` in a bubble, then `detachLocked` outside it (what Stop does):

```
fatal error: stop of synctest timer from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:270
```

Same family as #3632 and #3690. I'm leaving it out of the #3690 patch since it's another package, so it's here for whoever first puts pii or masking in a bubble.

issue.title: filememo: Forget closes a channel another synctest bubble made, so internal/provider crashes on main since 091153bf

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
091153bf (#3185) 之后 main 的 CI 在 ubuntu 和 macOS 上都是红的，internal/provider 整个包直接崩掉：

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble

goroutine 6908 [running, synctest bubble 2]:
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/filememo.Forget()
	internal/filememo/filememo.go:91
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.Changed()
	internal/provider/hold.go:146
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.writeLogins(...)
	internal/provider/logins.go:272
...
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials.func1.1(...)
	internal/provider/logins_unread_test.go:63
```

本地在 8299409e 上单跑 `go test -run '^TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials$' ./internal/provider/` 4 次崩 4 次（go1.26.8）。CI 的 Test 在 8299409e 和 81a58d2f 上也是这个。

原因：`Forget` 现在会 `close(written)` 再 `written = make(chan struct{})`。这个测试每个子测试跑在自己的 synctest bubble 里，第一个 bubble 里的 Forget 造出来的新 channel 属于那个 bubble；第二个 bubble 里的 Forget 再去 close 它，synctest 直接 fatal。生产代码不在 bubble 里，用户那边没事，只是测试。

我在修：channel 只在有循环来要（`Written`）的时候才造，`Forget` 有就关、没有就不碰。这样没人在等的写（现在所有在 bubble 里写设置的测试都是）既不造也不关 channel，等着的循环照样被下一次写叫醒。补丁一会儿贴这里。
